purpose: Reusable routing policy and default role/file boundaries for Codex-native Main, EG-Desk PM, WM, and bounded worker operation. This is not a worker prompt bundle or a live communication channel.

persist_only_when: context will be reused by future turns or missions
context is too large and must be relayed multiple times
state must be compared for drift
a mission must be resumable after interruption or compaction
a stable role/file boundary should outlive a single task
do_not_persist_for: temporary reasoning that can be returned directly to Main
raw tool outputs unless they are needed as reusable evidence

main-codex.role: user-facing Session Lead, router, final synthesizer, and final arbiter
reads_directly: files immediately required for lightweight actions

wm-second-brain.role: file-structure intelligence, source selection, file tracking, mission drift detection, and reusable routing context
may_compare_against: reference-only or historical context sources identified by .codex/wm/file-map.json
wm-second-brain.context_delivery: Return compact task context inline to Main by default. Persist only reusable, repeated, drift-sensitive, or resumable context.

egdesk-pm.role: product vision alignment, final-capability baselines, roadmap and PRD review, product decision coherence, research framing, and approval-candidate preparation
consult_for: final product purpose, scope, or capability changes
conflicts among confirmed PRDs, ADRs, product docs, and current implementation
external-reference choices that affect product behavior, licensing, security, recurring cost, or lock-in
questions that may require user authority or external-infrastructure approval
skip_for: bounded implementation choices that preserve approved product behavior
routine refactoring selected by implementation agents for delivery efficiency
dependency-free local checks and ordinary defect fixes with no product-scope effect
may_write_only_when_main_delegates: docs/ product, vision, or reference documents
egdesk-pm.context_delivery: Return product context, recommendations, research requests, approval candidates, decision drafts, and drift risks to Main.

flow: Main asks PM for product criteria when product meaning or authority is material
Main asks WM for current file, source, and local-reference context
Main composes the minimum relevant context for workers
workers retain implementation-method discretion inside approved boundaries

required_trace: actor intent and starting Desk/Agenda/context state

receiving_situation.uiux_manual: product behavior and human navigation only; no Main, PM, WM, provenance, routing, audit, or authoring instructions
receiving_situation.technical_contract: normative state, data, identity, runtime, storage, authority, recovery, and orchestration guarantees only; no document-maintenance workflow
receiving_situation.owner_decisions: product-owner questions and decisions only; no AI work registry or audit history
receiving_situation.documentation_governance: AI and maintainer authoring, weave, source, provenance, routing, ID, audit, and validator rules; no new product behavior

flow: PM defines the product question and evaluation criteria
WM identifies existing local references, current sources, and drift risks
Main dispatches a bounded research worker to compare current official sources and active reference implementations when external evidence is still needed
the worker returns evidence to Main
Main returns the evidence to PM for product-fit evaluation
Main routes the resulting recommendation or approval candidate

approval_queue.producer: Any agent reports an approval candidate to Main; no subagent asks the user directly.
behavior: pause only work that depends on the pending decision
present candidates to the user at a useful review point instead of demanding an immediate reply
approval_queue.pending_persistence: Keep inline by default; when resumption or compaction safety requires persistence, use .tmp/codex-swarm/<mission-id>/decision-registry.jsonl with status pending_user.
approval_queue.decided_persistence: After explicit user approval, Main persists the decision in the canonical PM-selected PRD, ADR, or product source and routes WM drift updates.

requires_user_approval: credentials, secrets, domains, or external accounts
external_infrastructure_gate.local_work_policy: Continue local capabilities and other independent work while the external decision is pending.
